question: Is there anything you keep in mind or are careful about when writing Natsuki Subaru? Also, if possible, please tell us the differences between Subaru in Arc 1 and Subaru as of Arc 10.
answer:
In Arc 1, it was the start of the series, so "How would Subaru react when placed in this situation?" hadn't been fully fleshed out yet. Though that wasn't unique to Subaru—Emilia in Volume 1 had a slightly prickly edge to her too.

By Arc 10, the core of the characters won't shift or bend, so they have changed dramatically.

As for things I'm careful about when writing: honestly, I no longer get lost when writing Subaru, so there's not much I have to be cautious about. I can only write Subaru as Subaru, so I don't get stuck there.
